concept.hr: Kad GPO nestane, pravilo se vraća, a preferenca ostaje
concept.en: When the GPO goes away, a policy reverts; a preference stays

summary.hr: Jedan GPO s pravilom i preferencom za ana na PC07: odspoji GPO i vrijednost u ključu Policies nestaje, a ProxyMode ostaje. Korisnik mijenja, osvježavanje vraća.
summary.en: One GPO with a policy and a preference for ana on PC07: unlink it and the Policies value goes, ProxyMode stays. The user edits it; a refresh puts it back.
